name: @cms/web
description: Framework-free TypeScript/DOM authoring application for the Handoff CMS. Bilingual (en/es), accessible (WCAG 2.2 AA + ATAG/COGA patterns), low-distraction authoring model that is a thin client over an injected AuthoringApi. Exposes immutable snapshots, typed commands, deterministic state, and one-action rollback. Never re-implements authorization; approve/publish/rollback always call the API.
